name: Vastwood Animist — target land becomes an X/X Elemental, X = Allies you control when the ability is fired
notes: Sweep group 2 (2026-10-07). Firing wrote "becomes an 3/3 Elemental creature until end of turn, where 3 is the number of Allies you control" and the leftover "where" clause (number, control) made the set-type parser skip the sentence. The clause is now cut from the type text and the article reads "a 3/3". Three Allies: the Forest is a 3/3 Elemental creature land.
